subject.title: test(ui): assert the Home run ring in chat run lifecycle e2e

question: Should the Web UI owner accept this focused E2E contract update for the Home running indicator now that the sidebar implementation uses the shared glyph ring?
rationale: The patch is narrow and evidence-backed, but the protected `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling rather than automated closure or repair.

options.title: Accept the E2E contract update
options.body: Merge after required checks finish if the owner agrees the shared glyph ring is the intended stable Home running-state signal.

options.title: Request a different assertion boundary
options.body: Keep the PR open only if the owner intends lifecycle tests to observe another user-visible Home state rather than the sidebar glyph contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the E2E contract update
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks finish if the owner agrees the shared glyph ring is the intended stable Home running-state signal.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the merged sidebar-indicator behavior and are best positioned to confirm the intended test contract.
